sources.title: Protecting Sea Turtles on Cape Cod

excerpts.quote: Cold-stunned sea turtle strandings mainly take place from November to mid-January
Do not assume a turtle is dead and do not put it back in the water
Carefully move the turtle above the high tide line. Never grab or hold the turtle by the head or flippers. Cover it completely with seaweed or wrack—never cover it with sand.
Mark it with an obvious piece of debris like buoys, or driftwood, or draw a big arrow in the sand. Call the Wellfleet Bay hotline at 508-349-2615, Option 2
